intro: Lesson 16. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ (٢٥) وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ (٢٦) يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ (٢٧) مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ (٢٨) هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ (٢٩) خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ (٣٠)

ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ (٣١) ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ (٣٢) إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ (٣٣) وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ (٣٤) فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ (٣٥) وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ (٣٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record And had not known what is my account.
I wish my death had been the decisive one. My wealth has not availed me.
Gone from me is my authority." [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
Then into Hellfire drive him. Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great, Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Haqqah 69:25-36 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 69:25-36 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 69:25-36 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, write two reasons given in 69:33 to 34 for his punishment.
questions.a: He did not believe in Allah, the Most Great; he did not encourage feeding the poor.

questions.q: Recite 69:28 to 29 with the saktah and explain it.
questions.a: مَالِيَهْ ۜ هَلَكَ: a short pause with no breath so the two haas stay apart (Hafs).
A) feeding the poor. 'Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor' (69:34).

questions.q: Think again: The man given his record in his left hand says 'my wealth has not availed me, my authority has gone'. What does he realise too late?
questions.a: That wealth and power cannot save anyone; he did not believe in Allah or encourage feeding the poor (69:33 to 34).
